extracted.intended_audience: prospective Echoing Green fellowship applicants (early-stage social entrepreneurs); partners and donors interested in fellowship criteria
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and implicit selection standards used by Echoing Green to identify, support, and fund early-stage social entrepreneurs and transformational leaders. Focuses on candidate potential, social-justice-oriented innovation, seed-stage ventures, and leadership development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brightest leaders with the best ideas for social innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: We find the brightest leaders with the best ideas for social innovation as early as possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on early identification of individuals (emerging leaders) whose ideas aim at social innovation; selection seeks promising leaders early in their trajectory rather than established organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevate indicators of potential beyond a business plan
rubrics_metrics.description: We've designed a world-class global search process that elevates better indicators of potential than a business plan alone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection values signals of founder potential (e.g., leadership, vision, adaptability) over solely a polished business plan; the process is global and intended to surface potential from diverse contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize diversity of experience and perspective
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritizes diversity of experience and perspective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recruitment and evaluation deliberately include varied backgrounds and viewpoints as a positive selection factor; diversity is treated as central to identifying high-potential leaders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transformational leadership (willing to speak truth to power)
rubrics_metrics.description: Raising up the transformational leaders willing to speak truth to power and challenge the status quo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for leaders who demonstrate courage, systems-thinking, and willingness to confront entrenched problems and power structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work at the intersection of social justice and social innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: We work at the intersection of social justice and social innovation, connecting our expertise and global networks to emerging leaders creating long-lasting social change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should align with both justice-oriented aims and innovative approaches to problem solving; emphasis on systemic and sustained change rather than short-term fixes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity to create long-lasting / positive systemic change
rubrics_metrics.description: Emerging leaders creating long-lasting social change; launching bold new organizations to create positive systemic change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should demonstrate how their work aims for systemic impact and durable outcomes rather than isolated or temporary benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seed-stage orientation: launching bold new organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowship Programs provide seed funding to social entrepreneurs launching bold new organizations to create positive systemic change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program targets founders at the seed/launch stage; viability and ambition of a nascent organization are key considerations for funding eligibility and fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leadership development and lifelong community support
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide seed-funding and leadership development to a new class of Fellows every year and welcome them into a lifelong community of leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is tied to provision of deep, ongoing leadership development and network access—assessment includes potential to benefit from and contribute to a long-term community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational values alignment: social justice, innovation, inclusivity, community
rubrics_metrics.description: Each of us approaches our work with passion and a dedication to supporting the change our Fellows are making in the world. We value social justice, innovation, inclusivity, and community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and projects that align with these stated values are better fits; evaluators will consider mission-value alignment as part of suitability for fellowship support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to strategic support and expert networks
rubrics_metrics.description: We are social entrepreneurs, nonprofit advisors, business strategists, data scientists, trained facilitators, and digital connectors. We have 30+ years of experience and are the leading incubator for social impact startups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Echoing Green emphasizes applicants' potential to leverage the organization's multidisciplinary support (strategy, data, facilitation, digital) — fit includes readiness to work with such advisors and networks.
